articles.title: How Does De-addiction Treatment Works?
articles.summary: De-addiction treatment works by reversing and rewiring the neural damage caused by Substance Use Disorder (SUD). SUD is seen as a chronic brain disorder and not a failure in one's moral values and willpower. This is due to the reason that the brain is structurally changed through chronic substance use and its effects on the mesolimbic dopamine pathway, the reward circuitry, which involves reward, motivation, and learning. Treatment involves medical detoxification and other clinical interventions in order to bring back the brain's balance, which makes it responsive again to natural reinforcers. The process of recovery becomes comprehensible. But only when it is viewed through a lens of clinical intervention, not a criminal process.
